decisions.statement: The destination is read from the repository the push landed in.
A repository declaring no destination fails rather than passing the copy over.
The copy runs after the push returns rather than while the client waits.
The runner leaves the process group.
The transport sweeps that process group.
The runner has no descriptor the client is waiting on.
One copy runs per repository at a time.
A push arriving while a copy runs leaves a mark the holder takes up.
A history copy pushes every branch and tag as those branches and tags are.
A snapshot copy pushes main's tree onto a lineage rooted at the destination.
A snapshot whose tree is unchanged is a copy that ran and pushed nothing.
The outcome of the run is left beside the repository for anything to read.

definition: the repository copied out to the destination the repository declares
